text:
Nora (CEO): Short weekly exec note — high level bullets for the company this week.
- Overall: good momentum. Product adoption up across two new SMB accounts; please make sure launch comms include support contacts.
- Metric focus: improve onboarding NPS from 62 -> 70 by end of Q. Small experiments on email flows and docs are live.
- Priority this week: finalize the SLA addendum for Dedicated customers and finish the Private deployment SOC checklist.

Anika (VP Product): Product highlights — the new prompt-validation tooling is in beta for 10 customer accounts. Early signal: reduction in bad-generation support tickets by ~40%. We'll expand to the next cohort on Friday.

Carlos (VP Eng): Engineering update — shipped the background cold-start cache which reduces median cold latency by ~18ms. Still tracking a sporadic memory leak in the worker pool under heavy synthetic load; engineers are on a patch and we'll do a canary tomorrow morning.

Ravi (Head of Security): Security/compliance note — privacy assessment for the EU Private deployment is in final review. Two small items: we need formal retention language in the onboarding contract and KMS rotation proof for one customer. Both low-risk but need Legal signoff.

Lena (Head of Customer Success): Customer note — flagged one Dedicated customer with degraded throughput yesterday for ~22m. We escalated and applied a temporary capacity bump; working with Eng for a permanent mitigation. If you have customers expecting launches this month, please add them to the CS spreadsheet.

Nora (CEO): Ops asks — all teams: if you are planning capacity increases >10% week-over-week, notify @ops at least 48h in advance. Also: marketing launches must include a short tech checklist in the PRD.

Carlos (VP Eng): Canary plan for the memory leak patch: 10% of worker fleet, 90m observation, auto-rollback on increased error rate or >5% OOMs. ops-bot will post results to #eng-sre.

Ravi (Head of Security): For the SLA addendum, Security and Legal will require a single-page exception form for any customer asking for non-standard data residency. We'll publish the template Monday.

Lena (Head of Customer Success): NPS experiment notes: new guided tour reduces time-to-first-success by ~25%. We'll A/B for two more weeks then decide.

ops-bot: Incident note posted: Dedicated throughput degradation (ticket 7219) mitigated at 2026-04-02T14:12Z. Runbook applied: temporary pool bump.

Nora (CEO): Closing — focus on customer reliability and finishing the SLA/SOC docs. If any team needs an unblock from leadership, DM me. Keep the comms short and copy Customer Success on launch emails. :white_check_mark:

(End of thread)
